title: Nice beige color, doesn’t move on floor, this rug is thin, not soft, and is small.
text:
Nice beige color, doesn’t move on floor, this rug is thin, not soft, and is small.. The color beige is a medium beige that can blend with most colors.
Has a rubber type of backing.
This indoor mat is thin, and not soft. I think it’s a stiff small rug, that kept the
Dirt on the top of the rug, although easy to shake it off outside.

I put the rug on the laminate floor At the side door Where the children come in. The rug moved around a little bit, not much.
I then put it at the sliding door that is carpeted, and this rug started moving around, although it says it is to used on
Plain floors.

Around the house and outside we are usually barefoot , and we did not feel this carpet Is soft or comfortable to wipe
Our feet on. I can compare it to My chenille throw rug on the floor at that door that It lol is soft , thicker and does a better job of
collecting dirt then This one, and does not move around.

I’m not a fan of this rug.
If I find this rug does a better job on dirt, I will be back to update my review.
